_comment: Maestro 2:00 demo video script. All voices ElevenLabs premade. Founder = Eric (smooth trustworthy middle-aged). Maestro = Brian (deep resonant comforting). Three staff radio voices for the cold open. Each line has a target wallclock time in seconds; the Playwright run logs the actual visual event times and ffmpeg anchors audio to whichever is later (max of (script target, visual event)).

lines.text: Suite twelve is a deep clean. Red wine on the rug. I need a glassware run.
Karp party landed at SFO. ETA one hour. Elite repeat guests. Suite twelve.
Madera main is fully booked tonight. I only have the bar.
That is the sound of a luxury hotel losing five thousand dollars of lifetime value.
This is Maestro. I am the GM. Watch.
Suite fourteen is prepped, with a horse card for Maya and gluten-free snacks. Madera Bar booked for four, at eight.
Same morning. Real life. Vendors fail.
Madera is offline. Switching to Mayfield.
No human re-prompted. Claude re-planned from partial state.
Now watch what happens when nobody is in the room.
The Karps are thirty minutes out. Suite twelve is dispatched. Maya's horse card is placed.
Every luxury hotel General Manager runs on three radios and a clipboard. We just gave them an agent.
